story: MA129 Music Therapy - Day 7 (Act 1: Discovery in the Shop)
note: Times are reel-relative seconds, half-open. Narrative order. Day 7 = the shop only (Neville + David). Beat 1.3 (the mom/dementia need) was NOT shot in the shop - it lives on D5 (driveway) and D6 (interviews/onstage). No interviews on this day.

selects.label: orchids
selects.quote: Look at you, beautiful thing... all the varieties of orchids in the world... All you want to do is bloom... You're a bit thirsty, aren't you?... all beautiful families, all from different places, but they're all shining individually and together

selects.label: call-smashing
selects.quote: Okay, Gail, well look, that's awesome. I'm gonna sit with Neville and talk that over with him, and we gotta come up with something pretty smashing... Thanks so much for calling

selects.label: trish-named
selects.quote: Neville, come on over a second... I love a ukulele story... a group of senior women that started a ukulele band at COVID, and they want to celebrate the person that started the group, named Trish. And so Gail just called and asked if we could do something special for her. Isn't that wild?

selects.label: ukulele-punch
selects.quote: These folks are celebrating a ukulele band created during COVID... seniors over 60, a group of women... playing at events to bring some happiness to people... 'do a Neville'... flowers dance, they're musical in their own right... a ukulele is a simple, diminutive little instrument that can pack a lot of punch and a lot of color and a lot of power, and carnations do the same thing... I'm just gonna surprise her. I'm gonna surprise them all

selects.label: share-love-bcam
selects.alt: A-04 @663.41 (ASR garbles the line; boom reset was called right after this take)
selects.quote: Won't this be great? I'm so excited because we get to share love through the beauty of flowers and music... I can hear those little ukuleles going now, and those flowers are gonna dance so beautifully through it... you go back to your business, and I'm gonna go do what I do

selects.label: dance-outro
selects.quote: Oh my goodness, I am so excited, and I know they are as well... I'm gonna make those flowers dance and sing and play right along with those ukuleles... I'm just dancing now... I'll see you later, orchids

selects.label: popcorn-string
selects.quote: Do you remember when we were kids and strung popcorn for Christmas? We're kind of doing the same thing... string those carnations... People say, oh my god, it doesn't hurt them. No... the whole idea is that I'm going to make sort of a musical note with these

selects.label: try-one
selects.quote: Do you want to try one? / No, you go - and that's the right answer. / I am many things; a florist is not one... Look at that

selects.label: bad-relationship
selects.quote: The best ones are the carnations, because carnations will hang on like a bad relationship and last forever and ever... some people say, I don't like carnations. Well, get over it, because they're beautiful... they're not a pretentious flower at all. They tend to play with everyone

selects.label: treble-clef
selects.quote: So you're not much of a music guy. / To play an instrument? Absolutely not... What's that squiggly thing? / That is a treble clef... like a very ornate number six... / Oh, that's exactly where I was going with that... I'm so smart with these words now... I can see the rings of Saturn on a clear night... too lazy and a little proud

selects.label: dance-curl
selects.quote: This is the fun part, because they're all just strung like popcorn... give them a little curl, so they'll dance... I want to see them dance and move and move and dance... / You'll get weeks out of that... Gail's gonna flip when she sees this

selects.label: not-just-a-carnation
selects.quote: Carnations are such an underrated flower... This is not just a carnation. This is a dance... lily grass... it is moving with the vibrations of the music... / It really does accentuate the dance, doesn't it? / And the trebles. And the cleft. Perfect

selects.label: finished-piece
selects.quote: Look at you. You're absolutely beautiful. I love it... That's terrific. Isn't it great? Here's some tea for you

selects.label: found-something
selects.alt: B-09 @2995.39; A-08 @1372.29 (earlier take of the same exit)
selects.quote: Honey, I found something else that's gotta go with this, and it's gonna be great. So I'm gonna grab it... and then I can get this on the way over to the event... She's gonna love it... You can have my tea... Bye, doll
